notes: Fixes: (1) Performance → System info tab was blank — a duplicate loadSysInfo function overrode the correct one; removed. (2) Delete-to-Recycle-Bin on files inside OneDrive-synced folders (Documents, Desktop, Downloads on corporate laptops) was refused. Deletion now narrows protection to true system paths (Windows, Program Files, ESET/Optima), allowing user content in OneDrive. OneDrive still keeps its own version history + bin.
